create_suo_initializer_with_defaults: create a ScaledUniformOrthogonal initializer with default scale, axis, and delta settings for DKS/TAT
create_suo_initializer_without_delta: create a ScaledUniformOrthogonal initializer with delta set to false for standard orthogonal initialization
create_suo_initializer_custom_scale: create a ScaledUniformOrthogonal initializer with a custom scale factor for weight rescaling
use_suo_initializer_in_haiku_module: use a ScaledUniformOrthogonal initializer in a Haiku module to initialize fully-connected layer weights
use_suo_initializer_for_conv_layers: use a ScaledUniformOrthogonal initializer with delta mode to initialize convolutional filter bank weights
